senses.gloss:
humours
------------------------------------------
According to आयुर्वेद, the science of health and longevity, the human body has three हुमोउर्स्, called ‘doṣas’, viz., kapha (phlegm), vāta (wind) and pitta (bile) which have to be kept in a state of balance, to maintain good health.
See ĀYURVEDA.
